 {#padminI, citriRI, SaNNinI#} and {#hastinI#} or {#kariRI#}. The Ratimañjarī
 thus defines {#citriRI:-- Bavati rasirasajYA nAtiKarvA na dIrGA tilakusumasunAsA#}
 {#snigDanIlotpalAkzI . GanakaWinakucAQyA sundarI badDaSIlA sakalaguRavicitrA#}
